body.name: Exact finite-array separately anchored endpoint energy
body.construction: For each post-period jump set \(a_{0tr,\ell}=-\Delta_{0tr,\ell}\) for the treated cell and \(a_{jtr,\ell}=w_{\ell j}\Delta_{jtr,\ell}\) for donor \(j\geq1\); retain both pairs \((a_{jtr,\ell},\widehat c_{jtr,\ell})\) and \((-a_{jtr,\ell},c_{jtr,\ell})\) as separate entries \((b_{tq,\ell},s_{tq,\ell})\), and set \(\Psi^{\mathrm{fin}}_{t,\ell}=-\tfrac12\sum_{q,q'}b_{tq,\ell}b_{tq',\ell}|\sqrt{m_\ell}s_{tq,\ell}-\sqrt{m_\ell}s_{tq',\ell}|\).
